meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会帮你管理网页项目里的 shadcn 界面组件：添加、搜索、修复、调试、改样式、组合界面，也能处理预设代码。动手前先查项目配置和组件文档；已装过的组件不会重复添加。
howto.when: 当项目带有 components.json、涉及组件注册表或 --preset 代码时，或用户要求执行 shadcn init / 切换预设时，自动接管。

say.text: 给项目添加一个登录页 block，用 @shadcn 注册表
say.note: 它会先查项目配置，再执行添加命令。

say.text: 帮我搜索一下可用的图表组件，列出来
say.note: 会运行 search 检索官方和社区注册表。

say.text: 把项目从 nova 预设换成 vega，先给出差异
say.note: 会先询问采用覆盖、合并还是哪种方式。

howto.what_en: Claude manages the project’s shadcn components and presets: adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI. It reads the injected project context and official docs before acting, and never re-adds installed components.
howto.when_en: Auto-triggers when the project has components.json, the user mentions registries or --preset codes, or asks for “shadcn init”, creating an app with --preset, or switching presets.

say_en.text: Add a login block to the project from the @shadcn registry.
say_en.note: It reads project config, then runs the add command.

say_en.text: Search available chart components and list them.
say_en.note: It runs the search command against registries.

say_en.text: Switch the project from nova preset to vega, preview the diff first.
say_en.note: It will ask whether to overwrite or merge.
